nodes.label: Fake News Detection Backend
nodes.summary: Production-ready Node.js + Express backend for a Fake News Detection System with JWT auth, role-based access, and Google Fact Check API integration.

nodes.label: Node.js Runtime
nodes.summary: Node.js v18+ runtime used for the backend server.

nodes.label: Express.js Framework
nodes.summary: Express.js web framework with ES Modules support used to build the HTTP API.

nodes.label: MongoDB Database
nodes.summary: MongoDB Atlas via Mongoose used for persistent data storage.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.summary: Stateless JSON Web Token authentication using bcryptjs for password hashing.

nodes.label: Joi Validation
nodes.summary: Joi library used for request payload validation and environment config validation.

nodes.label: Google Fact Check API
nodes.summary: Google Fact Check Tools API used to verify claims against existing fact-check reports.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture
nodes.summary: The project follows Clean Architecture with separation of concerns across controllers, services, models, middleware, and validations layers.

nodes.label: Auth Routes
nodes.summary: Public authentication endpoints: register, login, logout, and get current user.

nodes.label: Verification Endpoints
nodes.summary: News verification API endpoints: check claim text, analyze with NLP stats, and URL-based checking.

nodes.label: Admin CRUD Endpoints
nodes.summary: Admin-only endpoints for managing users, fact checks, reports, saved articles, and viewing dashboard analytics.

nodes.label: Fake News Verification Pipeline
nodes.summary: Multi-step pipeline: validate input -> extract claim -> query Google Fact Check -> aggregate ratings -> generate explanation -> persist to MongoDB -> return response.

nodes.label: Claim Extraction
nodes.summary: Statistical sentence scoring to identify the main assertion from long paragraphs, removing stop-words and punctuation.

nodes.label: Credibility Scoring
nodes.summary: Converts raw fact-check ratings to standardized verdicts (true/false/mixture/unverified) and calculates confidence score.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control
nodes.summary: Separate user and admin permissions enforced via middleware.
